mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are seeing clear skies and a comfortable 79 degrees at Fireman's Park, with the moon currently in its Third Quarter phase.

In city news, the new Tai Chi Animal Frolics sculpture has officially been installed at Century School Park. This art piece was created by local artists Gene Delcourt and Christian Felland and reflects traditional Tai Chi movements through carvings in a reclaimed ash tree.

There is plenty to do in Verona today, including the Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, live music at Paddy Mac's, and the Pizza and a Pitcher event at the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, you can also join Hop Haus for trivia tomorrow.

Looking at the police report from last week, on August 30, officers responded to the 800 block of North Edge Trail after a witness reported a man intentionally smashing a vehicle window. The suspect was identified, and an arrest warrant has been issued.
Today's delicious flavor of the day is Oreo Reese's Cheesecake. The store is currently open for business and will remain open until 10 PM tonight, so stop by soon for a treat.
